text:
Alex K.: Just finished signup, verified email, added card, but trial credits aren’t showing. acct: acct_9XZ7
signup-bot: Welcome to Redwood! Free trial credits are applied after payment verification. Current status: pending_manual_review :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex K.: 3DS passed on my bank side and charge succeeded. Not seeing any credits in the console.
Maria S.: Hi Alex — sorry about that. Can you confirm the account id here and the billing country for the card? I’ll take a look.
Alex K.: acct_9XZ7, card **** 4242, billing country: US, signup IP: 3.80.12.99 (US)
billing-bot: Auto-check: account acct_9XZ7 flagged by heuristics -> reason: business_email_gate; action: require_business_review
Josh D.: @Maria I’m running an internal status check now.
Josh D.: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.internal/api/accounts/acct_9XZ7/status
```
Josh D.: Response snippet: ```json
{ "account_id": "acct_9XZ7", "trial_credits": 0, "gates": ["business_email_gate","manual_payment_review"], "payment_verified": true }
```
Maria S.: Looks like business_email_gate triggered — the signup used a corporate domain which puts the account into manual review for trials. Alex, did you sign up with a work email or personal one?
Alex K.: I originally used alex.personal@gmail.com earlier in the funnel but accidentally completed the account setup with alex@company.org. That’s my personal account but uses work domain address.
Maria S.: That explains it. Our policy flags company domains to prevent abuse; it moves the account to manual review. We can either (1) manually approve and grant the trial now, or (2) switch the account email to your personal email and auto-apply credits. Which do you prefer?
Alex K.: Manual approval is fine — would appreciate if you can grant it so I can test quickly.
Maria S.: OK — I’m escalating to Billing Ops for a manual grant. Need one verification item from you: can you DM me the bank txn id or last 4 + card authorization timestamp?
Alex K.: DM sent with txn id and last 4.
Josh D.: Created escalation ticket BILL-8932 and attached account dump + notes about email domain. Tagging Billing Ops and Trust & Safety. ETA 2-4 hours for manual review.
billing-bot: BILL-8932 created -> status: escalated; assignee: billing_ops_team
Maria S.: Quick update — Billing Ops approved manual grant. I’ve applied a temporary $50 trial credit to acct_9XZ7. It should appear in the console within 5 minutes.
Alex K.: Confirmed — credits just showed up. Thank you so much! :tada:
Maria S.: Closing the loop here. I left an account note to avoid re-gating for this email and flagged for follow-up with Product on improving the UX when users switch emails mid-signup. If you run into anything else, ping us.
